# Priscilla Grant

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** dream girl  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Priscilla is described as a pale, spiritual-looking maiden.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Personality

Despite her spiritual appearance, Priscilla is full to the brim of mischief, pranks, and fun. She is also a thoughtful, imaginative, and ambitious student.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Traits

- thoughtful  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

- ambitious  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- mischievous  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- fun-loving  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## History

Priscilla attended Queen's Academy, where she became part of a close circle of intimate friends alongside Anne Shirley and Stella Maynard.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_
